notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: authored_by is the model deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run wB2-196) and reviewed_by stays null; native.py, pythonnet, the Kinesis DLLs and the upstream package were never imported or run, and no hardware test was performed. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names PythonObjectDriver, but the package is a direct decorated Driver over the confirmed entry symbol piezo:PiezoController because the value is mode-dependent (percentage travel in closed loop, output voltage in open loop), the calibration uses the upstream a/b conversion, and the actions need outputs and preconditions that the family's static mapping cannot express. COVERAGE: reads value, units, closed_loop, reader_reading, reader_units and zeroing; writes value (operator_required) and closed_loop; actions x-cap.azdagkas.kinesis_piezo.move_to_home.v1 (also the safe-state action), jog_up, jog_down, calibrate_position, move_to_position (operator_required input) and zero_reader; @estop calls the native move_to_home. The value field has no single UCUM unit (percent in closed loop, volts in open loop), so it is declared with unit 1 and the units read reports the physical unit; reader_reading and the calibrated position use the reader display unit, reported by reader_units. The fake starts in closed loop with placeholder calibration and reader values (marked # placeholder) so the calibrated move can be exercised; the hardware driver refuses move_to_position until calibrate_position has run and refuses calibration in open loop. The only gate warning is G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for zero_reader: the action calls PiezoController.reader.set_zero(), and the gate's recorder wraps only the controller object, not the reader object the upstream class owns, so it cannot see the nested native call; the action returns the reader zeroing flag and the zeroing read changes, so it is not a no-op, and the upstream class has no controller-level zero method to call instead. NOT COVERED: the upstream reader display-mode changes (the clone has no setter), the move_pos_up, move_pos_down and move_pos_to_home convenience methods (the calibrated move and the jog actions are exposed instead), the open-loop voltage range beyond the operator-supplied value bound, the piezogui.py GUI and any device class other than PiezoController. The clone's README says the code was tested with Python 2.7 and 3.6; the lock install says python >=3.10 because the MHS SDK requires it. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the last check printed.
